name: Enclave Private Data Layer
description: Local-first privacy broker for private files, local chat, and WDVA adapter workflows.

repoRoot.description: Absolute path to the SLM Vault repository root.

vaultPath.description: Local vault directory used by Enclave.

profileName.description: Default Private Language Model profile used for local context and WDVA adapters.

pythonBin.description: Python interpreter used to launch the local bridge.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for bridge calls.

tools.name: enclave.status
tools.description: Show local Enclave, Sheriff, and WDVA/private-model readiness.

tools.name: enclave.ingest
tools.description: Ingest local files or folders into the encrypted local context index.

tools.name: enclave.chat
tools.description: Ask questions against the local encrypted context store.

tools.name: enclave.scan
tools.description: Run local risk scanning with the Sheriff privacy broker.

tools.name: enclave.protect
tools.description: Enable consent barriers for selected local paths.

tools.name: enclave.read
tools.description: Read a protected file through a valid Sheriff lease.

tools.name: enclave.adapters
tools.description: Inspect local WDVA adapters and the recommended model profile.
